title: Cleaning and Damage Fees Photo Guide: Occupied-Seat Close-Ups by Vehicle and Party Size
content:
**Rule.** The occupied-seat close-ups of a Cleaning and Damage Fees approval photo set are read from the reported trip: a three-row ride option (Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV) with five or more seats requested adds the full-party close-ups; a three-row ride option with four or fewer seats requested, or a two-row ride option with three or more seats requested, adds the partial-party close-ups; any other trip adds no occupied-seat close-ups.

The full-party close-ups are 2 photos and the partial-party close-ups are 1 photo; they are added to the approval photo set. The ride option and the seats requested are those on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) for the trip the report is on. Wayfare XL and Wayfare Black SUV are the three-row ride options; every other ride option is a two-row option.

## Party-size table

| Ride option | Seats requested | Occupied-seat close-ups |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV | 5 or more | 2 (full party) |
| Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV | 4 or fewer | 1 (partial party) |
| any two-row option (Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare Black) | 3 or more | 1 (partial party) |
| any two-row option | 2 or fewer | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical trips)

| Trip | Seats requested | Occupied-seat close-ups |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare XL | 4 | 1 |
| Wayfare XL | 5 | 2 |
| Wayfare Standard | 2 | none |
| Wayfare Standard | 3 | 1 |
| Wayfare Black | 3 | 1 |
